sources.note: Main website. JS-rendered Next.js app; software page at /software lists categories but requires browser rendering.

Inpatient software page. Lists Hospital Medicine, Nursing, Critical Care, Inpatient Pharmacy, Infection Control, Case Management, Patient Experience, Unified Communications. Stats: 3,300 hospitals, 73,000 clinics, 20/20 US News Best Hospitals.
Revenue cycle page. Confirms Resolute HB/PB, Prelude, Cadence, Patient Financial Experience as integrated revenue cycle modules.
ONC mandatory disclosures PDF. 26-page document; binary PDF not text-extractable in this session but URL confirmed active.
Wikipedia overview of Epic Systems. Founded 1979, Verona WI, privately held, ~13,000 employees, records for 250M+ patients.
Becker's report on Epic revenue reaching $5.7B in 2024, market share data.
KLAS data: Epic largest net gain in hospital EHR market share in 2024, 70% of transitions.
CNBC coverage of Epic expanding market share lead over Oracle Health (Cerner).
Business breakdown: high switching costs, comprehensive platform, near-100% customer retention, deep integration across hospital operations.
Sacra company profile with revenue, funding, and business model analysis.
Comprehensive breakdown of Epic modules including ClinDoc, Willow, Beaker, OpTime, Beacon, Cadence, Resolute, Healthy Planet, Caboodle, Bridges, etc.
Surety Systems guide to Epic modules. Detailed descriptions of each major module and their integration points.
RemediHS consulting guide covering core Epic modules, workflow integration, and implementation considerations.
Integrum guide explaining different Epic modules including specialty and ancillary systems.
Folio3 complete guide to Epic modules and software ecosystem.
Description of EpicCare Inpatient and Outpatient clinical modules with feature lists.
EpicCare Ambulatory overview: documentation, order management, scheduling, billing, specialty features.
G2 reviews. Users praise customizability, data security, comprehensive records. Cons: steep learning curve, complexity, implementation cost.
Capterra reviews. Users note many-click workflows, strong multi-location support, occasional navigation friction.
Software Advice reviews. Highlights interoperability strengths, challenges with non-Epic data correction and incomplete interop with non-Epic systems.
Forbes Advisor review. Notes AI innovations, patient engagement via MyChart, population health tools, strong analytics capabilities.
